summary:
We developed SpacefarmVN, an interactive 2D top-down educational game created for the "Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer" challenge. Set in the 22xx century on a Martian research base, the game puts players in the shoes of a junior astronaut tasked with cultivating food on Mars.
To address the challenge of training future explorers, our game simulates real scientific hurdles of extraterrestrial agriculture, such as toxic perchlorate salts in Martian regolith, low temperatures, thin atmosphere, and radiation. Inspired by actual scientific concepts, players use microorganisms in a bioreactor system to neutralize perchlorates and carefully manage controlled environments—balancing water, nutrients, light, temperature, and pressure—to grow protein-rich soybeans and other crops. Intuitive mechanics like a tutorial quest bar, tool inventory, and a time-skip clock make complex space science accessible and engaging.
SpacefarmVN is important because it inspires children and teens to explore space science through hands-on problem-solving. By turning abstract astrobiology and sustainable farming concepts into a fun mission, it teaches young minds that surviving on the Red Planet requires careful preparation, critical thinking, and scientific innovation.
details:
I. How It Works

Mars Genesis is a 2D top-down educational simulation game set in the 22xx century on a Martian research base. Players step into the role of a young astronaut tasked with establishing sustainable, on-site food production. Using an intuitive interface—featuring an item/seed inventory bar, a beginner mission guide, and an in-game clock with a "skip to next day" mechanic—players move around the base, operate scientific tools, plant seeds, tend to crops, and harvest produce. Starting with protein-rich soybeans, players must first treat toxic Martian regolith using a bioreactor system filled with specialized microorganisms to break down harmful perchlorate salts. Once treated, players cultivate crops within controlled environments—regulating water, nutrients, light, temperature, and atmospheric pressure—and send harvest data back to Earth to unlock new plant varieties.

II. Benefits & Intended Impact

Mars Genesis bridges the gap between complex space science and young learners:

  • Educational Benefits: The game transforms abstract concepts in astrobiology, chemistry, and space agriculture into hands-on, interactive problem-solving activities.
  • Intended Impact: We aim to inspire the next generation of space explorers by showing that surviving on Mars requires careful scientific preparation, environmental management, and critical thinking—starting from the simple act of planting a single seed on the Red Planet.

III. Tools, Languages & Technologies Used

  • AI Assistance: We used Gemini to generate custom 2D visual assets and Claude to assist with writing, debugging, and refining the game's source code.
  • Game Engine & Coding: Godot (GDScript).

IV. Creativity & Innovation

Rather than treating space farming as simple gardening, Mars Genesis incorporates real-world Martian chemistry into gameplay. Simulating the use of bioreactors and microorganisms to neutralize toxic perchlorates makes the game scientifically authentic while remaining fun and accessible. Furthermore, the "next-day" time-skip feature solves the pacing challenge of real-time plant growth, keeping young players engaged throughout the mission.

V. Key Factors Considered by Our Team

  • Scientific Realism: We accounted for actual environmental hazards on Mars, including low temperatures, a thin atmosphere, radiation, and perchlorate toxicity, as well as the nutritional value of starter crops like soybeans.
  • User Experience (UX) for Youth: We designed a clear top-down view, straightforward controls, and step-by-step tutorial quests so young players can easily grasp complex scientific workflows without feeling overwhelmed.
  • Future Scalability: While the current version focuses on crop cultivation, we structured the game world to easily expand into water recycling, energy management, and advanced greenhouse controls in future updates.
